faq.desc: Everything you need to know about our 3D interior & exterior design services.

items.q: What software do you use for 3D Interior & Exterior Design?
items.a: We utilize industry-leading software including Autodesk 3ds Max, V-Ray, Lumion, and SketchUp. This allows us to deliver photorealistic renderings with stunning accuracy in lighting, materials, and spatial detail.

items.q: What information do you need to create a 3D rendering?
items.a: We typically need architectural drawings (floor plans, elevations, sections), material specifications, and any design inspiration images. If you don't have detailed blueprints, we can work with sketches or rough ideas.

items.q: How long does it take to create a 3D interior rendering?
items.a: The timeframe varies depending on complexity and detail level. A standard interior rendering typically takes 3-7 business days. Exterior designs may take 5-10 days. We also offer express delivery for urgent projects.

items.q: Do you offer revisions to the 3D rendering?
items.a: Absolutely! We include revision rounds in every project. We incorporate your feedback on materials, colors, furniture placement, lighting, and camera angles until you are 100% satisfied with the final output.

items.q: How much do your 3D Interior & Exterior Design services cost?
items.a: Pricing is project-specific and depends on complexity, space size, and detail level. Our interior rendering services start from ₹8,000 per view. Contact us for a free, customized quote tailored to your project.

items.q: Can you create both interior and exterior renders for the same project?
items.a: Yes! We offer comprehensive packages that include both interior and exterior visualizations. This gives a complete picture of your project and is ideal for real estate marketing, client presentations, and architectural approvals.

items.q: Why choose Auctech IT Solutions for 3D design in Lucknow?
items.a: With 10+ years of experience, 500+ completed designs, and a dedicated team of 3D artists, we are Lucknow's most trusted 3D design company. We combine cutting-edge technology with creative mastery to deliver results that consistently exceed expectations.

items.q: Do you provide animated 3D walkthroughs along with static images?
items.a: Yes, in addition to high-resolution photorealistic still images, we create fully immersive cinematic 3D walkthrough animations that allow you to virtually tour the designed space.
